Agent Name: InformationExtraction_Expert
, Step Number: 3
, Reason for Mistake: The agent misidentified the APOD city as Duluth without verifying the caption and then incorrectly linked the “city’s namesake” to Chicago’s John Hancock Center (and SOM). The APOD (2015-08-03) shows the lights of Marquette, Michigan; its namesake (Jacques Marquette) corresponds to Chicago’s Marquette Building, designed by Holabird & Roche (Holabird & Root as of June 2023). The error stems from unverified assumptions and a faulty namesake connection, leading to the wrong firm/name.
